tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The XPIA Pass Through Crimping Tool is a professional-grade networking tool designed for efficient and precise termination of RJ45 and RJ11/12 connectors. Compatible with CAT5, CAT5e, and CAT6 cables, this tool is ideal for network technicians, installers, and DIY users.


Featuring a pass-through crimping design, it allows wires to pass through the connector before crimping, ensuring accurate alignment and reducing installation errors. The built-in cutting and stripping functions make it a multi-purpose tool, simplifying cable preparation and saving time during installation.


Constructed with durable steel and ergonomic handles, the XPIA crimping tool provides comfortable grip, long-lasting performance, and consistent crimping results. It is perfect for use in LAN setup, CCTV installation, telecom work, and structured cabling projects.


Key Features


  • Supports RJ45 and RJ11/12 connectors
  • Compatible with CAT5, CAT5e, CAT6 cables
  • Pass-through crimping design for precise alignment
  • Built-in cutter and stripper functions
  • Durable hardened steel construction
  • Ergonomic, non-slip handle for comfortable use
  • Ensures secure and reliable cable termination
  • Ideal for networking, ISP, and CCTV installations
